sentences.text: Main Case No. W.P.Nos.36083 of 2013 & 33130 of 2016

OFFICE No. NOTE  09.04.2025 VN, J  W.P.No.33130 of 2016 is filed  declaring the action of the Respondents in not handing over the alternate site to an extent of 665 Sq.Yards earmarked in LP.No.421/81 as per resolution No.249 dated 28.05.1985 passed by the 2nd respondent in lieu of Petitioner's land to an extent of 665 Sq.Yards which was part of 1047 1/9 square yards situated in T.S.No.1966/1, Block No.16 (Old Block No.2) Dairy Farm Area, Suryaraopeta, Kakinada and also not permitting the Petitioner to make constructions in the balance extent of land as illegal and arbitrary.
W.P.No.36083 of 2013 is filed declaring the action of Respondents in laying the road in part of Petitioner's house site of a total extent of 1047 sq.yards in T.S.No.1967/1, Kakinada Municipal Corporation withing payment of compensation and without initiating any action as per the provisions of Sections 146 & 147 of the Hyderabad Municipal Corporation Act, 1955 or under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act or by private negotiations as illegal and arbitrary.
Courter affidavit is filed in WP.No.33130 of 2016.
Even though nearly 12 years had elapsed, counter affidavit is yet to file in WP.No.36083 of 2013.

The case of the Petitioner is that though the Respondents have taken over the land of Petitioner referred above for laying road, no compensation was paid nor TDRs or alternate site is provided.
Learned standing counsel seeks time to get instructions.

Considering the claim made by the Petitioner, if by the next date, the counter and steps taken by the Respondents regarding the claim are redressed, this Court would be compelled to call upon the concerned Commissioner to be present before this Court.
